title: Optimising the metric, not the forecast: code and data release
description:
Final pipelines, per-iteration traces and farm-level result tables from three years of an automated post-processing loop on a provincial Chinese wind fleet: 106 runs, 5,360 iterations and 1,202 accepted code edits. The loop raised the grid-code accuracy score by 1.02 points; the gain survived a change of evaluation subset, a change of site and two holdout designs, but did not survive a change of loss, where capacity-normalised squared error worsened in 64% of runs.

The archive contains the artefacts of every run (final transform() code, metadata, per-candidate steps, per-iteration traces), the seven result tables behind the manuscript's Tables 2-9, the scripts that turn those tables into every printed number and into Figures 2-6, and the search loop itself for inspection. A verification script re-checks 134 printed values; 134/134 pass, with three 0.01-level rounding differences documented.

The metered output and issued forecast series are commercially restricted and are not included; a de-identified sample is available from the authors on request.
